body: Tired of the regular old Minecraft foods? Well this mod has you covered! This mod adds a few more foods and a new biome! New features include burger vending machines and a burger block. This adds a variety of foods that are easy to craft and plentiful. And if you are ever hungry, just put down a burger machine and eat as many burgers as you can!
